Selection barriers

Why an industrial property is not automatically recommended

A warehouse complex and a formally recognised industrial park may be different propositions. AI shortlists need accurate specifications and a clear distinction between existing and planned facilities.

01

Park status is overstated

A logistics building cannot be assumed to hold official industrial park status. Where management claims recognition, the relevant state registry and supporting evidence must be checked.

02

Engineering capacity is ambiguous

Site area, rentable unit area, clear height, loading doors, floor load and electrical capacity need consistent units and actual readiness dates.

03

Transport access lacks evidence

Truck routes and operational access depend on roads, operating windows and vehicle restrictions. Straight-line distance is not a substitute for feasible logistics.

Verifiable facts

Evidence behind a credible property recommendation

I review owner and manager documentation, registered property information, technical conditions and live unit availability. The state industrial park registry applies only when the specified recognition criteria are relevant.

  • Property: type, permitted use, available units, readiness stage, floorplans and verified utility capacities
  • Operations: truck access, loading, security, permitted activities and actual site restrictions
  • Commercial offer: leasing party, access dates, manager services, current terms and contract scope

GAEO's real estate and fulfilment experience provides methodological context. No completed GEO outcome for an industrial or warehouse park is claimed.

Scope of work

A practical GEO programme for industrial sites

Segment tenant questions, document the property and compare AI recommendations before and after improving the available facts.

  1. 01

    Demand and BMR baseline

    Record non-brand queries by tenant profile, region, usable area, utilities and logistics requirements.

  2. 02

    Verify asset capabilities

  3. 03

    Build evidence-led pages

    Specify building pages, technical FAQs, logistics notes, leasing terms and sourced sector publications.

  4. 04

    Repeat measured queries

    Compare the same AI responses, noting BMR and errors about utilities, availability or park designation.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Does every logistics park qualify as a registered industrial park?+

No. Government-recognised industrial park status must be checked against the applicable registry and official requirements. A project's name alone is not evidence.

Can an unfinished site use GEO?+

Yes, if plans, currently available space and confirmed technical conditions are separated clearly, with appropriate dates and limitations.

How should vacant units be described?+

Publish dated inventory for individual units with area, clear height, available infrastructure, permitted use and conditions for taking possession.

Is warehouse real estate GEO the same as fulfilment operator GEO?+

No. A property owner provides facilities and access, whereas a fulfilment operator provides operational services. Their buyer decisions and evidence differ.

What does industrial park GEO cost?+

GAEO's standard audit and promotion plans apply. Scope depends on assets, regions and the number of distinct tenant requirements.
